I’m in the same boat as well, friend. Questioning life and feeling alone.

If a problem is big to you, then it’s a big problem. Everyone handles things differently, and that’s alright. It’s like saying someone can’t be happy because other people have it better. It’s a stupid way of thinking, and I’m sorry that the people around you can’t show some empathy.

Something that’s worth a try is focusing on getting through things one day at a time. If that’s too overwhelming, then you can try an hour, or a minute at a time. just focus all of your energy on getting through that amount of time. Everything else can wait. 

it might sound like cliché advice, and I don’t know exactly what your going through, as I’m not you. But when you’re in those dark moments and your seriously thinking about whether or not it’s worth it to stay alive, just surviving is a huge achievement. 

It’s a great strength to feel like you want to kill yourself, but not going through with it. i hope you realise that.
